# components/code

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/code/code.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { codeHtml, CodeBlock } from "@tundralibs/ui/code"`

Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/code.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `codeHtml`

```ts
codeHtml(trusted: string): Html
```

Highlighted markup a server-side highlighter produced, as `Html` for
{@link CodeBlockProps.highlighted}. ONLY EVER PASS MARKUP THE SERVER
GENERATED FROM CODE IT HOLDS — never user input, never a request body:
this is `raw()`, nothing is escaped.

### `CodeBlock`

```ts
CodeBlock(props: CodeBlockProps): Html
```

A block of code: optional file name, language chip and copy button in
the header, numbered and highlightable lines, wrapping or a height cap.
Colour comes from a server highlighter's markup (`highlighted`), from
code.js's small tokenizer for the common languages, or not at all —
the block never depends on a script to be readable. Each line is its
own `.code__line`, so numbers and highlights are CSS and never reach
the clipboard.

## Types

### `CodeBlockSize`

How tall the block may grow before it scrolls inside itself: 12 / 20 / 32 rem.

- `"sm"`
- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `CodeBlockProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `id` | `string` |  |  |
| `code` | `string` |  | The source, escaped like any text. Give this *or* `highlighted`. With a `language` that code.js knows (`json`, `bash`, `css`, `html`, `js`, `ts`, `python`, `php`, `java`) the block is coloured on the page by a small best-effort tokenizer; any other language renders plain. |
| `highlighted` | `Html` |  | Markup a server-side highlighter produced — Prism, highlight.js or Shiki with class themes — wrapped with {@link codeHtml}. The kit colours both libraries' class names (`.token.keyword`, `.hljs-keyword`) and its own `.tok-*` set from the theme's tokens. Hand-written markup marks a run inside a line the same way: `<span class="tok-mark">` emphasises it, `tok-quiet` quietens it. TRUSTED: only ever markup the server made from code it holds. |
| `language` | `string` |  | Shown as a chip in the header and set as `language-<x>` on `<code>`. |
| `title` | `string` |  | A file name or caption in the header. |
| `aside` | `Html` |  | Beside the title, before the copy button: a status badge, a link. |
| `lineNumbers` | `boolean` |  | Number the lines (CSS counters; never part of the copied text). |
| `highlightLines` | `number[]` |  | 1-based lines to emphasise — a changed line, the one a doc talks about. |
| `wrap` | `boolean` |  | Wrap long lines instead of scrolling sideways. |
| `maxHeight` | `CodeBlockSize` |  | Cap the height; the block scrolls inside itself past it. |
| `copy` | `boolean` |  | A copy button in the header, copying the raw source. @default true |
| `copyLabel` | `string` |  | Accessible name of the copy button. @default "Copy code" |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A snippet in the docs

Numbered, with the two lines the text talks about emphasised; code.js colours `ts` on the page.

```ts
CodeBlock({
  title: "routes/projects.ts",
  language: "ts",
  lineNumbers: true,
  highlightLines: [3, 4],
  code:
    'import { Card } from "@tundralibs/ui/card";\n\nexport const ProjectCard = (p: Project) =>\n  Card({ title: p.name, body: p.summary });\n',
})
```

```html
<figure class="code code--numbered" data-code>
  <figcaption class="code__header">
    <span class="code__title">routes/projects.ts</span>
    <span class="code__lang">ts</span>
    <span class="code__copy">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm btn--icon btn--copy" data-copy="import { Card } from &quot;@tundralibs/ui/card&quot;; export const ProjectCard = (p: Project) =&gt; Card({ title: p.name, body: p.summary }); " data-copy-announce="Copied" aria-label="Copy code">
        <span class="btn__copy-label" data-copy-label>
          <svg width="15" height="15" width="2" width="12" height="12" …>…</svg>
        </span>
        <span class="btn__copy-done" data-copy-done>
          <svg width="15" height="15" width="2" …>…</svg>
        </span>
      </button>
    </span>
  </figcaption>
  <pre class="code__pre" tabindex="0">
    <code class="code__body language-ts" data-highlight="ts">
      <span class="code__line">import { Card } from &quot;@tundralibs/ui/card&quot;;</span>
      <span class="code__line"></span>
      <span class="code__line code__line--hl">export const ProjectCard = (p: Project) =&gt;</span>
      <span class="code__line code__line--hl">Card({ title: p.name, body: p.summary });</span>
    </code>
  </pre>
</figure>
```

### A server highlighter's markup

`codeHtml()` is `raw()`: only ever markup the server made from code it holds (Prism, highlight.js, Shiki with class themes).

```ts
CodeBlock({
  language: "js",
  highlighted: codeHtml(
    '<span class="token keyword">const</span> n <span class="token operator">=</span> <span class="token number">1</span><span class="token punctuation">;</span>',
  ),
})
```

```html
<figure class="code" data-code>
  <figcaption class="code__header">
    <span class="code__lang">js</span>
    <span class="code__copy">
      <button type="button" class="btn btn--ghost btn--sm btn--icon btn--copy" data-copy="const n = 1;" data-copy-announce="Copied" aria-label="Copy code">
        <span class="btn__copy-label" data-copy-label>
          <svg width="15" height="15" width="2" width="12" height="12" …>…</svg>
        </span>
        <span class="btn__copy-done" data-copy-done>
          <svg width="15" height="15" width="2" …>…</svg>
        </span>
      </button>
    </span>
  </figcaption>
  <pre class="code__pre" tabindex="0">
    <code class="code__body language-js">
      <span class="code__line">
        <span class="token keyword">const</span>
        n
        <span class="token operator">=</span>
        <span class="token number">1</span>
        <span class="token punctuation">;</span>
      </span>
    </code>
  </pre>
</figure>
```

### An API reply: a status beside the title, runs marked by hand

`aside` takes any `Html`. In `highlighted` markup, `tok-mark` emphasises a run and `tok-quiet` quietens one; escape the text yourself, `codeHtml()` is `raw()`.

```ts
CodeBlock({
  title: "POST /v1/links",
  aside: Badge({ variant: "success", label: "201 Created" }),
  highlighted: codeHtml(
    '{ "id": <span class="tok-mark">"lnk_8Hq2"</span> } <span class="tok-quiet">// the new link</span>',
  ),
})
```

```html

        <span class="btn__copy-label" data-copy-label>
          <svg width="15" height="15" width="2" width="12" height="12" …>…</svg>
        </span>
        <span class="btn__copy-done" data-copy-done>
          <svg width="15" height="15" width="2" …>…</svg>
```

### A tall log, capped and wrapping

```ts
CodeBlock({
  language: "bash",
  code: "deno task build\ndeno task build:demos\nCI=1 HERMETIC=1 deno task test\n",
  maxHeight: "sm",
  wrap: true,
  copyLabel: "Copy commands",
})
```

## Behaviour

`components/code/code.js` ships in `ui.js` (delegated on `document`, re-initialised after a rAPId swap).

Attributes it reads or writes: `data-highlight`, `data-highlighted`.

Events: `rapid:swapped`.
